findings.explanation: The client owns your work immediately upon creation, even if you have not been paid for it.
findings.suggested_change: Work Product ownership shall transfer to the Contractor until the Client has satisfied all commercial obligations under this Agreement.

content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body:
Hello,

Before signing the agreement, I would like to propose a modification to the relevant clause.

- The relevant clause states that the client owns the work immediately upon creation, even if payment has not yet been made. I propose that Work Product ownership shall transfer to the Contractor until the Client has satisfied all commercial obligations under this Agreement.

Best regards
